description:
You are a facilities manager / energy engineer. The tenants on the middle floor of the 4StoreyBuilding are complaining about dry air in winter and high humidity in summer. You need to update the eQUEST model to include active humidity control on the Middle Floor systems.

Your task is to modify ALL five Middle Floor (M.*) Packaged Single-Zone (PSZ) HVAC systems with the following parameters:

1. Enable humidification by setting the Humidifier Type ('HUMIDIFIER-TYPE') to 'ELECTRIC'.
2. Set the Minimum Humidity ('MIN-HUMIDITY') to 30%.
3. Set the Maximum Humidity ('MAX-HUMIDITY') to 60%.

After applying these changes to all five M.* systems (M.S16, M.E17, M.N18, M.W19, M.C20), run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to quantify the energy impact. Save the project when finished.

Note: You must locate these systems in the Air-Side HVAC module. No specific navigation steps are provided.
